_comment: Golden design constants. See golden/README.md for the naming convention and CLAUDE.md Golden designs. Do not hand-edit numbers without re-running the CLI.

launch.description: Real Taoglas EMPCB.SMAFSTJ.B.HT SMA + impedance-matched CPWG launch (gap 0.2512mm, ground inner edge 0.8512mm, feed 1.2mm, 6 stitch vias/side, solved 50.00 ohm) -- topologies/cascade.py TAOGLAS_SMA, the actual default for every cascade mesh since 2026-08-31.

shape_check.note: Fine mesh: 3 reflection zeros (2.81/2.85/2.92 GHz); interior ripple peak -14.53 dB; worst in-band S11 is at the upper target-band edge (2.94 GHz).

known_open_item: NOT spec: S11w -11.15 dB vs -16 dB, bw 182 MHz vs 143.5 MHz. Fabricated as a prototype with these deviations written down (docs/final_check/REPORT.md).

supersedes.why: End cavities trimmed -0.3 mm after a coupling-matrix fit showed them ~19 MHz low. Same fine-mesh model: golden -10.71 dB -> this -11.15 dB worst in band, interior ripple -11.15 -> -14.53 dB. Chosen over 4 other fine-mesh variants (l_cav1 -0.6, w_iris +0.6, w_ext +0.4 combinations) in docs/final_check/tuning_summary.json.

provenance.reproduce_with: uv run python docs/final_check/run_final.py 4 -0.3   (fine mesh 2.5/0.45 mm, coax ports 0.15 mm, h_air_factor 12, 2.72-3.02 GHz step 5 MHz, needs ~6 GB RAM)
